description:
Why Cutting 1 Onion Makes Your Eyes Cry in 10 Seconds! — You are not sad at all—yet 1 tiny onion makes you cry in 10 seconds!
Kids science answer for "why onions make you cry for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Slicing onion cells mixes enzymes and sulfur compounds into an invisible gas that floats to your eyes and triggers tears to wash the eyes clean.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
